title: Procedures for Withdrawal from a Regional School Unit
before:
The procedures for withdrawal of a municipality from a Regional School Unit (RSU) or School Administrative District (SAD) are in accordance with Title 20-A MRS §1466: Withdrawal of a single municipality from a regional school unit.

  • List of Withdrawals and Plans since FY 2013
  • New School Administrative Unit To Do List (after withdrawal process is complete)

Important Deadline

In order for a town to withdraw from a Regional School Unit, the final referendum vote by the town to approve the withdrawal agreement must have been completed by November 30 of the prior year in which the town hopes to withdraw, effective July 1 (per Title 20-A MRS §1466, subsection 5A).

For example, if a final referendum vote to approve the withdrawal agreement is held by November 30, 2026, the effective date of withdrawal can be July 1, 2027 (School Year 2027-2028). However, if a final referendum vote to approve the withdrawal agreement is held after November 30, 2026, the effective date of withdrawal cannot be until July 1, 2028 (School Year 2028-2029).

notes: 1 section header — too few for a contents list.

decisions.label: Set an over-long heading as the paragraph it is
decisions.why: 1 heading runs past 100 characters — the longest here is 289. "In order for a town to withdraw from a Regional School U…" is body text that was set as a heading to make it stand out, so it is announced as a section of the page and, at h2, written into the contents list as a link. It becomes a paragraph. Any anchor on it is kept, so existing links still land, and not a word changes.

decisions.label: Tag a document link with the format it opens
decisions.why: 2 links on this page open a file — 2 Excel — and say nothing about it, while others in the same list carry a tag because their author typed one. The format is read from the file name, so the list stops being half-labelled. No link text changes.

decisions.label: Drop the dash once the link is set apart
decisions.why: 3 of those items separate the link from its description with a dash. The link is now set in the display face at a larger size with a chevron after it, so the dash marks a boundary that is already unmistakable. Only the separator is removed — no word changes.

decisions.label: Separate a link from its description
decisions.why: 4 list items open with a link and then explain it, all at the same weight — so the thing you can click is no easier to find than the sentence about it. The link becomes the item and the explanation sits under it.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
